\multicolumn{9}{@{}p{\linewidth}@{}}{\footnotesize Qwen3.6-35B-A3B on hard45, no web access, two independent runs per side and per harness (90 attempts), thinking switched off at the server, not in the harness: a chat template that closes the think block before generation, no reasoning parser, and the \texttt{<think>} token banned by a logits processor, so all three harnesses see the same model.  \emph{solved} counts attempts with reward~1 over the attempts that are usable (scored, no infra exception); 7 thinking-off and 2 thinking-on attempts were lost to verifier faults (\texttt{verifier\_incomplete}, one \texttt{VerifierTimeoutError}) and were not rerun, which is why some denominators are below 90 and why the OpenCode pairing is over 44 tasks: \texttt{django-13449} voided in both thinking-off attempts.  \emph{per-task mean} is the mean outcome of a task over the usable attempts of that side, and the comparison is paired over the tasks both sides scored ($n$ $=$ 45, 45 and 44); $\Delta$ is off $-$ on in percentage points.  \emph{up / down} counts the tasks whose per-task mean rose / fell; the sign test is the two-sided exact binomial on those tasks, the remaining tasks being ties.  This is one $k{=}2$ observation on 45 tasks.  Three caveats.  Both OpenCode arms here run \emph{without} the pre-placed ripgrep, because the thinking-off arm had none either; they are therefore not the OC-rg arm of the main tables.  The Claude Code arms carry reasoning effort \texttt{xhigh}, its setting throughout this paper.  And mini-SWE-agent's \texttt{reasoning\_chars} are visible narration duplicated from the message text, not hidden thinking, so its reasoning length is not comparable with the other two and is omitted here.  The second block is a different experiment: HY4-Preview through the vendor's API under Claude Code, one run per side on the same 45 tasks, with thinking switched off by setting the API's thinking field to disabled --- the endpoint treats a missing field as on --- instead of at the serving layer.  With one run per side a per-task mean is 0 or 1, so \emph{up / down} are the discordant tasks and the two-sided sign test on them is McNemar's exact test.  At Tencent's list price the trial costs 2.86 CNY with thinking on and 2.14 with it off, from mean output of 43.9k and 17.5k tokens per trial.} \\
